newsitem.title: BELGIUM: INSIGHT - Chartists cautiously optimistic on Bel-20.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Chartists cautiously optimistic on Bel-20.

text.p: Belgian analysts turned more optimistic on the Bel-20 share index after last week's all-time record, although some warned the bourse was beginning to look toppish.
The Bel-20 ended at 1,773.21 points on Friday, down slightly from Thursday's record close at 1,773.98 points.

CERA - In the bond markets the rally continues, long-term interest rates remain low, the Belgian-German (10-year yield) spread is at a historical low, the dollar is above 1.52 marks... the key factors of a strong performance of the Brussels stock market over the next few days! First resistance is at 1,800. First support is at 1,750, second at 1,700. -- Guy Sips.

ECOFIS - A further advance of equities cannot be excluded given the continued decline in Belgian long-term interest rates. Further declines in European bond yields must be limited over time, among other reasons, because government bond markets are overbought. At present the Bel-20 remains in an extended top formation. The uninterrupted divergence between the RSI and the Bel-20 over the last 10 months testifies to that thesis. Finally, the Dow also displays topping over the last two weeks. -- Frank Boll.

GENERALE BANK - Consolidation continues. After having broken resistance at 1,765 after two weeks of range trading, the index briefly hit an intraday 1996 high at 1,781 before setting a 1996 closing high just below 1,774. The market looks as if it is in a congestion phase: most indicators point to difficulties to move higher, though very little evidence is around that it will move lower. Momentum is slowing and the 200-day exponential average is flat as ever. -- Geert Vanderbeke.

PARIBAS - On the daily chart we continue to favour the ascending triangle pattern with the 1,780 level (May 23 high) as the crucial level to break on the upside and the 1,755 level as the bottom. A break of the triangle on the upside would put our medium-term target at a level between 1,850 and 1,890. The hourly chart is signalling a bull trend, a higher dollar against the mark and continuously lower long-term yields are some other arguments for positioning long on the Bel-20. -- Philip Tortelboom.
